summary: Completed P0 research, repository and fidelity foundation, including the actual packaged native media prerequisite in ADR0012. The isolated product imports immutable synthetic media, inspects exact bounded frames, seeks and reopens its library. Reviewed source is public with passing Windows/Linux CI. This is foundation acceptance, not completion of the recorder/editor or user-video workflow.

known_limits: P1-P10 remain required; no real Codex login/editing or user-example workflow is accepted.
Library records are ingestion records, not projects, draft timelines or undo history.

Preview is bounded BGRA full-range GBR BT.709 SDR. Other supported imports are preserved with preview unavailable. Native canvas equality covers tested opaque frames; display compositing and arbitrary alpha are not verified.
No audio listening or continuous A/V playback, Windows capture/device/installer behavior, lossless real-time capture throughput, or signed release is established.
Canonical master profiles are bounded BT.709 mono/stereo fixtures; packet timing, production compositing and wider metadata/precision support remain later work.
Private artifacts remain local and are not published; artifact links require the original evidence workspace.
